resources.string: Allows authenticated remote navigation, playback and text editing in the current TV app. Does not record screen content or typed text.

NORMAL SETUP
Install the APK with a TV APK installer. Developer options and debugging can stay off.

1. In Connection settings > Driver, select NVIDIA Shield and On-device control.
2. Open Accessibility settings and enable TV remote control under downloaded/installed services.
3. Optional: enable playback control and media reporting (notification access), plus current-app reporting (Usage Access), using Advanced options.
4. Save & apply, then Start. Open on phone shows the remote QR.

Playback uses Android media sessions or exposed Accessibility controls, including faded controls when the player keeps them accessible. App support varies. External volume support depends on the connected TV/receiver and is reported as unknown.

NORMAL SETUP
Install the APK with a TV APK installer. Normal Sony IP control does not require Developer options or debugging.

1. Enable the TV IP-control feature and pre-shared-key authentication in its network/remote-control settings. Menu names vary by model.
2. Enter the matching pre-shared key and local Sony API URL in Connection settings > Driver.
3. Optional: enable TV remote control in Accessibility for focused Android text entry. Usage Access and notification access add app/media reporting.
4. Save & apply, then Start. Open on phone shows the remote QR.

Some custom keyboards do not expose standard text controls. The explicit developer text fallback is available for those cases.

OPTIONAL DEVELOPER FALLBACK
Use this only when normal on-device control cannot perform the required action.

1. In Android TV Settings, open About (sometimes under Device Preferences or System). Select Build / Android TV OS build seven times to enable Developer options.
2. Enable USB debugging and, where provided, Network debugging. Record the displayed port.
3. Authorize a trusted computer using the TV Allow debugging prompt. The app needs an existing authorized RSA key in private storage; the documented development installer/key-import helper requires a development APK.
4. For Shield, choose Developer mode (ADB fallback) in Connection settings > Driver. For Sony, enable Developer-mode text fallback. Match the local ADB port and authorized key file.
5. Debugging must remain enabled while this fallback is used. Normal control never silently enables or switches to ADB.

The project README describes the advanced key setup. Accessibility permission alone does not authorize ADB.
